Overview of LoongArch ISA structure and extensions. It doesn't say when PGDL or PGDH is used.

grades.quote: See Basic Control and Status Registers for details of how each CSR register above interacts with the TLB.
grades.reason: It only lists PGDL, PGDH and PGD among the TLB-related CSRs. It gives no condition for choosing PGDL over PGDH.

grades.quote: This register is used to configure the base address of the global directory for the lower half address space.
grades.reason: It says PGDL holds the global directory base for the lower half address space. It defines that space as addresses whose [VALEN-1] bit is 0, which is the condition for using PGDL instead of PGDH.
